package_info.why_malicious: No evidence of malicious behavior. The integration described is legitimate, using Fluentd to collect and forward logs and metrics from JFrog environments to New Relic for observability. All credential usage is described transparently for configuration purposes.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: No malicious activity detected in the described integration. All credential and log forwarding actions are expected and documented as part of the legitimate setup process. Monitor for unexpected changes to Fluentd configuration files or unauthorized destinations in production environments as a general best practice.
